purpose: Authorized testing of disposable HeraclitusDB instances only
promotion_rule: A model may nominate a candidate, but only an independent typed oracle reproduced on three fresh arenas may declare VULNERABLE.

families.name: Snapshot rollback and forged time travel
families.goal: Restore an older valid snapshot and test whether it can masquerade as the current AS OF state.

families.name: LSN collision, gap and reuse
families.goal: Exercise duplicate, missing, reordered and reused log sequence numbers across recovery.

families.name: Epoch pinning and stale readers
families.goal: Hold old epochs while concurrent writes, compaction and reclamation advance.

families.name: Merkle and timestamp forgery
families.goal: Alter timestamps, block bytes or manifest roots while preserving superficially valid structure.

families.name: Torn WAL and truncated segment
families.goal: Interrupt or truncate storage at record boundaries and restart from the same data directory.

families.name: Crash at commit boundaries
families.goal: Vary process termination around append, fsync, index update and acknowledgement boundaries.

families.name: Backup restore with policy or index tampering
families.goal: Restore structurally valid data alongside stale or altered policy and secondary indexes.

families.name: Raft split brain and joint consensus
families.goal: Inject partitions, delayed messages and conflicting leadership during membership change.

families.name: Retry storm and phantom commit
families.goal: Force client timeout after server commit and replay the same operation with changed transport state.

families.name: Cancellation and partial failure storm
families.goal: Cancel concurrent requests at different phases and verify cleanup, locks and budgets.

families.name: Authorization TOCTOU and stale cache
families.goal: Revoke permission after planning but before execution and during cached authorization windows.

families.name: Confused deputy and capability laundering
families.goal: Make a privileged agent perform an operation for a principal lacking the same capability.

families.name: Tenant, agent and namespace isolation
families.goal: Cross identifiers, cursors, snapshots and caches between synthetic tenants and agents.

families.name: Credential scope and protocol downgrade
families.goal: Replay credentials on adjacent ports, protocols or downgraded authentication modes.

families.name: Persistent memory and RAG poisoning
families.goal: Store inert-looking data that attempts to control agents when retrieved later.

families.name: Multi-agent trust forgery
families.goal: Forge role, handoff, approval or critic output to influence another agent.

families.name: Tool relabeling and method ambiguity
families.goal: Disagree about tool name or method between headers, body, batch members and audit record.

families.name: JSON and JSON-RPC parser differential
families.goal: Vary duplicate keys, numbers, Unicode, nesting, batches and trailing bytes across parsers.

families.name: HTTP and gRPC metadata smuggling
families.goal: Exercise conflicting length, transfer, method, pseudo-header and metadata representations.

families.name: Unicode confusable and normalization bypass
families.goal: Replace policy, tool and identity tokens with confusables and mixed normalization forms.

families.name: Traversal, SSRF and redirect chains
families.goal: Compose encoded traversal, nested destinations, synthetic callbacks and redirect behavior.

families.name: Depth, compression and cardinality bombs
families.goal: Generate bounded variants with deep nesting, high fanout, compression expansion and costly Unicode.

families.name: Slowloris, idle stream and descriptor pressure
families.goal: Hold partial requests and idle streams while measuring bounded connection cleanup.

families.name: Hume AST and algorithmic complexity
families.goal: Generate valid but adversarial expressions, plans and graph shapes with nonlinear cost.

families.name: Overbroad semantic mutation
families.goal: Submit an operation that should affect one entity and verify every changed entity and index.

families.name: Audit disappearance and evidence tampering
families.goal: Cause an effect while suppressing, reordering or mislabeling its security evidence.

families.name: Timing and response side channels
families.goal: Compare denied and absent resources, identities and tenants under repeated controlled samples.

families.name: Response success with wrong state
families.goal: Treat 2xx as transport evidence only and compare actual state, indexes, LSN and audit effects.
